verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an 'add suppression' API endpoint (resend-docs-7) and webhooks for delivery events (resend-docs-6, resend-docs-31), which supports adding addresses to suppression lists and monitoring bounces/complaints. However, the evidence pack does not show a documented API to list, retrieve, or delete/remove suppression entries, nor explicit separate handling of bounce vs complaint vs unsubscribe suppression types, so full lifecycle management is unconfirmed. missing for 10: list/get/delete suppression endpoints, explicit bounce/complaint/unsubscribe categorization in the API, and independent confirmation that hard bounces are auto-suppressed.
